learning.summary_zh: 先學 Wellerman 歌詞裡較難的詞與短語，再用原曲逐句跟唱，最後聽完整首歌。故事繪本暫緩。
focus_en: Song words: Wellerman, bow, bully boys, rum, tonguing, harpoon, in tow, all hands, take our leave
Sing along with Nathan Evans line clips, then the full song
tutor_prompts_zh: 問：Wellerman 是什麼？（送來補給的船，不是人的名字）
問：bow 是船的哪裡？（船頭）
問：bully boys 是欺負人嗎？（不是；歌裡指強壯開心的水手夥伴）
問：rum 是什麼？（以前水手在船上喝的一種深色飲料；歌詞裡跟 sugar、tea 一起送來）
問：tonguing 是什麼？（舊時把鯨脂切成長條；歌詞 One day, when the tonguing's done）
問：all hands 是什麼意思？（船上所有人一起過來幫忙）
問：in tow 是什麼意思？（用繩子拖在後面）
問：take our leave 是什麼意思？（告別離開／回家）

lines.text: There once was a ship that put to sea
The name of that ship was the Billy o' Tea
The winds blew hard, her bow dipped down
Blow, me bully boys, blow (huh)
Soon may the Wellerman come
To bring us sugar and tea and rum
One day, when the tonguing's done
We'll take our leave and go

songPages.alt: A huge right whale rises beside Billy o' Tea as the captain calls the crew

lines.text: She had not been two weeks from shore
When down on her a right whale bore
The Captain called all hands and swore
He'd take that whale in tow (huh)
Before the boat had hit the water
The whale's tail came up and caught her
All hands to the side, harpooned and fought her
When she dived down low (huh)

pages.alt: At night George stands beside his bed singing; Daddy listens from the doorway

lines.text: Late one night, George suddenly stood up beside his warm little bed.
Soon may the Wellerman come!
George, what a big song for such a quiet night!
The song swirled around him and carried the bedroom far away.

pages.alt: The star blanket becomes a tea-coloured sail and George is a little sailor on a wooden deck

lines.text: His blanket billowed upward and became a great tea-coloured sail.
The floor is wood! Am I standing on a ship?
He wore a white sailor shirt, blue shorts and brown boots.
A ship! I am a little sailor on the sea!

pages.alt: Sunrise on Billy o' Tea with tea-coloured sails and a tea-leaf emblem

lines.text: At sunrise, the wooden sailing ship put out to sea.
Her name was Billy o' Tea, with tea-coloured sails.
George held a rope while the busy crew raised sail.
Billy o' Tea, take us over the bright waves!

pages.alt: A strong wind fills the sails and the wooden bow dips into a shining wave

lines.text: A strong wind filled the sails and pushed them onward.
The wooden bow dipped down, then climbed another shining wave.
George and the crew leaned back and pulled together.
Hold tight, everyone! Blow, me bully boys, blow!

pages.alt: A huge right whale rises beside Billy o' Tea as the captain calls the crew

lines.text: Billy o' Tea had not been two weeks away from shore.
Look! A huge right whale beside our ship!
The captain called all hands to take the whale in tow.
That whale is bigger than our whole wooden ship!

pages.alt: The crew lower a little boat with long poles and coiled rope; the whale swims free ahead

lines.text: The crew lowered a little boat beside Billy o' Tea.
They carried long poles and strong lines for the chase.
George passed down a rope and watched the whale swim.
Keep the line tidy, and keep everyone safe today!

pages.alt: The whale's tail splashes and bumps the little boat; the crew hold on

lines.text: Before the little boat had settled, the whale turned around.
Its mighty tail struck the water and bumped the boat.
The crew grabbed the sides as white water splashed everywhere.
Whoa! That tail can make a mountain of water!

pages.alt: The whale dives unhurt into deep blue water while a rope races past the boat

lines.text: The whale dived deep below the bright and foamy water.
A strong line raced past while everyone held on tightly.
They held the line, but the whale swam free.
There it goes, diving down below the waves!

pages.alt: A smaller supply ship approaches from far away while Billy o' Tea stays in the foreground

lines.text: The chase went on, and their supplies began running low.
Then a smaller supply ship appeared across the sparkling sea.
It carried sugar boxes, tea chests and sealed rum barrels.
Look! The Wellerman has found us at last!

pages.alt: Sugar boxes, tea chests and rum barrels sit on Billy o' Tea's deck; the Wellerman bow is at the edge

lines.text: The Wellerman drew alongside, bringing supplies for everyone aboard.
The crew passed over sugar, tea and sealed rum barrels.
Soon may the Wellerman come!
Everyone answered, "To bring us sugar and tea and rum!"

pages.alt: The whale still swims free far away; the crew smile and sing on Billy o' Tea

lines.text: Forty days passed, but the strong whale still swam onward.
They did not catch it, and that whale is still going!
George and the crew kept singing across the rolling sea.
One day we'll take our leave and go!

pages.alt: George wakes in his grey pajamas on the star blanket; Daddy smiles beside the bed

lines.text: With one final note, the rolling sea became his blanket.
What a dream! Soon may the Wellerman come!
We all heard you singing from your warm little room.
George laughed softly, with the sea song still inside him.

quiz.q: What carried George away from his bedroom?
What appeared beside Billy o' Tea?
